primaryHandbook.reviewMethod: Read rendered full pages for every cited claim; paraphrase the safety guidance and write a new scenario with one answer supported by it. Numeric legal limits, fines, permit equivalence and clinical treatment are excluded.
limitations: This handbook supports safety training content; these drafts do not claim to be an official examination bank or a complete examination syllabus.
Independent content review is still required. No production import, verification, activation or taxonomy write has been performed.
Thai, Russian and exam-English question/choice fields are null.
